Title: Base Workshop: B20 Token Standard
Description: A practical walkthrough of B20, Base's native token standard. Go beyond basic ERC-20 transfers: learn how to use built-in compliance controls (allowlists, freeze, pause), role management, transaction memos and supply caps. Then follow a live demo to launch your own token or stablecoin in one call and make it pay its own gas. Bringing a laptop is recommended but not required.

Title: Base Workshop: Denim Upgrade
Description: Get under the hood of Denim, Base's next major network upgrade. This technical session covers 200ms native blocks (five per second), millisecond onchain timestamps and the key architectural changes behind them, plus the code changes and optimizations needed for latency-critical apps and Flashblocks. Includes a live demo of 200ms blocks landing in real time. Bringing a laptop is recommended but not required.

Title: Base Workshop: Money Legos
Description: Consumer finance is moving onchain. In this hands-on workshop you combine Base's core primitives (stablecoins, tokenized assets, yield, swaps and identity) with protocols already live on Base, like Morpho, Aave and 0x, to build full-stack financial apps such as neobanks, brokerages and payment rails. Includes a live demo of agent workflows for building on Base. Bringing a laptop is recommended but not required.
